questions.question: What does the universe comprise?
options: All forms of matter and energy in space and time
Only the observable portion of space
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states, 'The universe comprises all of existence: all forms of matter and energy in space and time.'
Incorrect. The universe comprises more than just planets and stars; it includes all forms of matter and energy.
Incorrect. The universe is much larger than just the Milky Way galaxy.
Incorrect. The universe includes both observable and unobservable portions.

Incorrect. 93 billion light-years is the diameter of the observable universe, not the expansion time.
Incorrect. 4.84% is the percentage of ordinary matter, not a time duration.
Incorrect. 25.8% is the percentage of dark matter, not a time duration.
